 About the match
 On this page you can find the Lecce vs Genoa match lineup for Serie A — Round 10 - First Leg, on Sunday 01-11-2026, along with the substitutes and the players missing from the squad. Lecce lines up in a 4-3-3 led by Falcone, while Genoa sets up in a 3-5-2 led by Vasquez. Lecce is led by head coach Eusebio Di Francesco, while Genoa is managed by Daniele De Rossi. The match is played at Stadio Ettore Giardiniero - Via del Mare.
